CONTACT invokes whole-group building admission, then individual IndoorActorDispatch, then tactical manoeuvre. Individual START preserves PLANNING, busy same-contact paths and native target identity through IndoorActorNativeContext.

CortexFireControl implements close-threat target/fire for unreserved stationary actors and a CANFIRE-driven suppression opportunity. It preserves moving actors and applies ammunition, muzzle, suppression and line-of-fire guards. This is production-path evidence, not physical equivalence.
